items.message: Version is not used for direct trigger tasks

Removed. Its boolean shape could not express the new inline default, and it was gated on an outbox flag that no longer exists. Use AutoTransitionMode: Scheduled for the old true behavior; Inline (the default) is the new one.

Removed with the transactional-outbox continuation path. The scheduler is now the only delivery path; a failed enqueue is retried briefly and then reported instead of being deferred to the Inbox relay.
Removed. Latest-only instance loading is now unconditional — the canary rollout it gated has completed. History readers must use the repository full-history APIs.
